source_evidence.fact: Historical announcement/result press releases are linked by auction year; complete machine-readable coverage was not proven.
The official query advertises date-range export formats and document identity/filename fields, but no per-document publication clock.
The sample announcement identifies CUSIP 912810TX6, nominal 30-year bond, auction date 2024-02-08, original issue date 2024-02-15, and an 08:30 A.M. embargo line.
The sample result identifies the same issue and says For Immediate Release, but exposes no exact publication clock.
The public fiscal route exposes record_date as date-only, which cannot prove published_at or available_at.

timestamp_rule: Never use caller metadata, retrieval time, HTTP retrieval time, or date-only record_date as published_at/available_at; preserve the 16:15 America/New_York cutoff.
